title: "EPC & Price Paid Data — Cleaning & Merge"
output: html_document

# 0. Libraries

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
```

---

# 1. Load Price Paid Data (PPD)

```{r load-ppd}
files <- list.files(
  path = "data_gov",
  pattern = "*.csv",
  full.names = TRUE
)

ppd_cols <- c(
  "transaction_id", "price", "date_of_transfer",
  "postcode", "property_type", "old_new", "duration",
  "paon", "saon", "street", "locality",
  "town_city", "district", "county",
  "ppd_category_type", "record_status"
)

read_ppd_year <- function(path) {
  read_csv(
    file = path,
    col_names = ppd_cols,
    col_types = cols(
      transaction_id    = col_character(),
      price             = col_double(),
      date_of_transfer  = col_datetime(format = ""),
      postcode          = col_character(),
      property_type     = col_character(),
      old_new           = col_character(),
      duration          = col_character(),
      paon              = col_character(),
      saon              = col_character(),
      street            = col_character(),
      locality          = col_character(),
      town_city         = col_character(),
      district          = col_character(),
      county            = col_character(),
      ppd_category_type = col_character(),
      record_status     = col_character()
    ),
    progress = FALSE,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}

ppd_all <- bind_rows(lapply(files, read_ppd_year))
```

---

# 2. Filter & Clean PPD

```{r clean-ppd}
ppd_clean <- ppd_all %>%
  # Keep standard residential active transactions only
  filter(ppd_category_type == "A", record_status == "A") %>%
  # Remove invalid prices and missing dates
  filter(!is.na(price), price > 0, !is.na(date_of_transfer)) %>%
  # Restrict to Greater London
  filter(county == "GREATER LONDON") %>%
  # Normalise join key fields
  mutate(
    postcode   = trimws(toupper(postcode)),
    paon_clean = trimws(toupper(str_extract(paon, "^[^,]+"))),
    saon_clean = str_extract(
      toupper(saon),
      "(?<=FLAT |APARTMENT |UNIT )([\\dA-Z]+)"
    )
  ) %>%
  # Drop redundant columns (all same value after filtering)
  select(
    transaction_id, price, date_of_transfer,
    postcode, paon, saon, paon_clean, saon_clean,
    street, town_city, district,
    property_type, old_new, duration
  )

# Sanity check
cat("PPD rows:", nrow(ppd_clean), "\n")
cat("Duplicate transactions:", ppd_clean %>% count(transaction_id) %>% filter(n > 1) %>% nrow(), "\n")
```

---

# 3. Load EPC Data

```{r load-epc, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cert_files <- list.files(
  "epc",
  pattern = "certificates.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

epc_cert <- bind_rows(lapply(cert_files, read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE))

cat("EPC rows loaded:", nrow(epc_cert), "\n")
```

---

# 4. Clean EPC — Flats

Flats have ADDRESS2 populated. ADDRESS1 = flat descriptor (SAON), ADDRESS2 = building number + street.

```{r clean-epc-flats}
epc_flats_deduped <- epc_cert %>%
  mutate(
    postcode   = trimws(toupper(POSTCODE)),
    saon_clean = str_extract(
      toupper(ADDRESS1),
      "(?<=FLAT |APARTMENT |UNIT )([\\dA-Z]+)"
    ),
    paon_clean = trimws(toupper(str_extract(ADDRESS2, "^\\d+")))
  ) %>%
  # Flats: ADDRESS2 is present and saon_clean extracted
  filter(!is.na(ADDRESS2), !is.na(saon_clean)) %>%
  select(
    lmk_key                     = LMK_KEY,
    postcode, saon_clean, paon_clean,
    lodgement_date              = LODGEMENT_DATE,
    current_energy_rating       = CURRENT_ENERGY_RATING,
    current_energy_efficiency   = CURRENT_ENERGY_EFFICIENCY,
    potential_energy_rating     = POTENTIAL_ENERGY_RATING,
    potential_energy_efficiency = POTENTIAL_ENERGY_EFFICIENCY,
    heating_cost_current        = HEATING_COST_CURRENT,
    heating_cost_potential      = HEATING_COST_POTENTIAL,
    hot_water_cost_current      = HOT_WATER_COST_CURRENT,
    lighting_cost_current       = LIGHTING_COST_CURRENT,
    property_type_epc           = PROPERTY_TYPE,
    built_form                  = BUILT_FORM,
    construction_age_band       = CONSTRUCTION_AGE_BAND,
    total_floor_area            = TOTAL_FLOOR_AREA,
    number_habitable_rooms      = NUMBER_HABITABLE_ROOMS,
    floor_level                 = FLOOR_LEVEL,
    flat_storey_count           = FLAT_STOREY_COUNT,
    walls_description           = WALLS_DESCRIPTION,
    roof_description            = ROOF_DESCRIPTION,
    windows_description         = WINDOWS_DESCRIPTION,
    mainheat_description        = MAINHEAT_DESCRIPTION,
    main_fuel                   = MAIN_FUEL,
    mains_gas_flag              = MAINS_GAS_FLAG
  ) %>%
  # Keep most recent EPC per property
  arrange(postcode, saon_clean, desc(lodgement_date)) %>%
  group_by(postcode, saon_clean) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("EPC flats (deduped):", nrow(epc_flats_deduped), "\n")
```

---

# 5. Clean EPC — Houses

Houses have no ADDRESS2. Full address is in ADDRESS1 (e.g. "13, Durell Road"). Extract leading number as PAON.

```{r clean-epc-houses}
epc_houses_deduped <- epc_cert %>%
  mutate(
    postcode   = trimws(toupper(POSTCODE)),
    saon_clean = str_extract(
      toupper(ADDRESS1),
      "(?<=FLAT |APARTMENT |UNIT )([\\dA-Z]+)"
    ),
    paon_clean = trimws(str_extract(toupper(ADDRESS1), "^\\d+"))
  ) %>%
  # Houses: no flat descriptor, but has a leading number in ADDRESS1
  filter(is.na(saon_clean), !is.na(paon_clean)) %>%
  select(
    lmk_key                     = LMK_KEY,
    postcode, saon_clean, paon_clean,
    lodgement_date              = LODGEMENT_DATE,
    current_energy_rating       = CURRENT_ENERGY_RATING,
    current_energy_efficiency   = CURRENT_ENERGY_EFFICIENCY,
    potential_energy_rating     = POTENTIAL_ENERGY_RATING,
    potential_energy_efficiency = POTENTIAL_ENERGY_EFFICIENCY,
    heating_cost_current        = HEATING_COST_CURRENT,
    heating_cost_potential      = HEATING_COST_POTENTIAL,
    hot_water_cost_current      = HOT_WATER_COST_CURRENT,
    lighting_cost_current       = LIGHTING_COST_CURRENT,
    property_type_epc           = PROPERTY_TYPE,
    built_form                  = BUILT_FORM,
    construction_age_band       = CONSTRUCTION_AGE_BAND,
    total_floor_area            = TOTAL_FLOOR_AREA,
    number_habitable_rooms      = NUMBER_HABITABLE_ROOMS,
    floor_level                 = FLOOR_LEVEL,
    flat_storey_count           = FLAT_STOREY_COUNT,
    walls_description           = WALLS_DESCRIPTION,
    roof_description            = ROOF_DESCRIPTION,
    windows_description         = WINDOWS_DESCRIPTION,
    mainheat_description        = MAINHEAT_DESCRIPTION,
    main_fuel                   = MAIN_FUEL,
    mains_gas_flag              = MAINS_GAS_FLAG
  ) %>%
  # Keep most recent EPC per property
  arrange(postcode, paon_clean, desc(lodgement_date)) %>%
  group_by(postcode, paon_clean) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("EPC houses (deduped):", nrow(epc_houses_deduped), "\n")
```

---

# 6. Split PPD into Flats and Houses

```{r split-ppd}
ppd_flats  <- ppd_clean %>% filter(!is.na(saon))
ppd_houses <- ppd_clean %>% filter(is.na(saon))

cat("PPD flats:", nrow(ppd_flats), "\n")
cat("PPD houses:", nrow(ppd_houses), "\n")
```

---

# 7. Join

Flats join on `postcode + saon_clean` (paon_clean too unreliable for flats).  
Houses join on `postcode + paon_clean`.

```{r join}
flats_joined <- ppd_flats %>%
  left_join(epc_flats_deduped, by = c("postcode", "saon_clean"))

houses_joined <- ppd_houses %>%
  left_join(epc_houses_deduped, by = c("postcode", "paon_clean"))

merged <- bind_rows(flats_joined, houses_joined)
```

---

# 8. Match Rate & Validation

```{r validate}
# Overall match rate
merged %>%
  summarise(
    total      = n(),
    matched    = sum(!is.na(lmk_key)),
    unmatched  = sum(is.na(lmk_key)),
    match_rate = round(matched / total * 100, 1)
  )

# Match rate by flats vs houses
flats_joined %>%
  summarise(type = "flats", total = n(), matched = sum(!is.na(lmk_key)),
            match_rate = round(matched / total * 100, 1))

houses_joined %>%
  summarise(type = "houses", total = n(), matched = sum(!is.na(lmk_key)),
            match_rate = round(matched / total * 100, 1))

# Duplicate check — should be 0
cat("Duplicate transactions:", merged %>% count(transaction_id) %>% filter(n > 1) %>% nrow(), "\n")
```

---

# 9. Save Final Dataset

```{r save}
write.csv(merged, "london_epc_ppd_merged.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: london_epc_ppd_merged.csv\n")
cat("Final dimensions:", nrow(merged), "rows x", ncol(merged), "columns\n")
```
